content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text enters UNDERDETERMINED for the Acts 2:30 loins/seed row by treating the competing readings as unresolved, which invokes K-S2's bar on treating a multi-sense verse or row as open.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. The two readings: (1) neither chain forces the other is a permissible chain-level tie; (2) it treats the loins/seed row's two senses as open, which the rule forbids. I relied on reading (2).","why":"Because the judge marks the Acts 2:30 loins/seed row UNDERDETERMINED by treating the loins-at-depth and only-named-Davidic-man readings as unresolved two-sense alternatives, it does what K-S2 forbids."}
